listings.title: Virtual Estate Sale - Contents of Multi Million Dollar Main Line Estate
listings.description: 🏡 Shop a spectacular Main Line estate from the comfort of your home! This week, we’re hosting an online virtual estate sale featuring the contents of a beautiful multi-million-dollar Main Line home. The clients opted for an online sale rather than opening their home to an in-person estate sale. Here’s how it works: We removed the smaller items and brought them back to our Bryn Mawr office, where they’ll be listed in our online store. The furniture was photographed and remains in the home. As pieces sell, our team will pick them up and arrange delivery directly to the buyers. Everything goes LIVE Sunday at 9 AM! No lines. No waiting. No rushing through the house. You can browse the entire sale from the comfort of your home, and we’ll handle the logistics afterward. Smaller items can be shipped, while furniture can be delivered. The furniture and home décor in this estate are beautiful, and we can’t wait for you to see everything. Have fun shopping! 🛍️ ShopSBH.com
